metadata.name: Rwanda International Circuit — 2026 Grand Prix layout
metadata.description: Clockwise 5.30 km circuit at Bugesera rebuilt from the 2026 Tilke / dar / Wurz design: plateau main straight, RwandAir ridge sweep, descent to the lakeside hairpin, the Thousand Hills S-bends and the Qatar valley. 52 m elevation range.
metadata.author: procedural rebuild (Blender)

racingLine.method: lap-time optimised (quasi-steady VF26 model, B-spline pattern search), physics-AI validated
